g.text: Four probabilities are exactly 100% by integer equality. The others remain below the frozen 95% requirement.

g.text: Orange: three initially correct models can become wrong after hypothetical extra positives. If a false orbit remains

g.text: unwitnessed, the stronger 32-label likelihood can overcome the unchanged complexity prior. L2 improves to 91.69%.
